decisions.reason: At constant coefficient backgrounds, I_F extracts the theta^1 theta^2 coefficient, so [c]_F=0 for any numerical constant c. Replacing F_rem,lambda by F_rem,lambda+hbar^L c leaves the action, normalized expectations and Ward identities unchanged. The original coefficientwise equality therefore lacked a representative convention; the repair fixes its constant coefficient to the ultraviolet value and proves every positive-field-degree coefficient separately.
